behavioral_evidence.value: Edge-level triangle cohesion of the training co-occurrence graph, aggregated per item and rank-transformed into a bounded behavioural curvature coordinate s_i: the second-order (neighbour-of-neighbour) cohesion degree of an item in its own behavioural neighbourhood, not raw popularity and not sequential order.

Built from the training split only. Pass 1 over training sequences: undirected co-occurrence counts n_ij (distinct-sequence support, self-pairs dropped) and item degrees; keep top-M = 50 neighbours per item by n_ij to form N(i). Pass 2 over the retained edge list: T_ij = |N(i) intersect N(j)| by sparse sorted-set intersection, coh(i) = mean over incident edges of log1p(T_ij) (isolated items get coh = 0). Then rank-normalise coh over all 24556 training items into s_i in (-1,1), zero-mean. No validation or test sequence is read.

coh and s are frozen before Stage 2 starts and are built from training sequences only; the SID construction, the Sinkhorn cost and L_curv never call the validation or test loaders, and the reported homogeneity and Stage 3 metrics are computed after assignment from held-out data that enters no gradient. Because s is a precomputed constant vector, no evaluation interaction can leak into the codebook through Stage 2 gradient descent.

geometric_necessity.value: Fixed negative curvature c = 1.0 (ball radius R_c = 1): origin exponential map exp_0^c(v) = tanh(sqrt(c)||v||)*v/(sqrt(c)||v||) applied to the Euclidean latent and to the codewords; Poincare distance d_c(x,y) = (2/sqrt(c))*artanh(sqrt(c)||(-x)(+)y||); and codeword curvature anchor a_k = tanh(sqrt(c)||e_k||), the hyperbolic depth of a code.

Inside quantization, in the level-1 Sinkhorn cost matrix (distance term) and, through a_k, in the behaviour offset of that same matrix; and in the level-1 soft assignment P produced by the balanced Sinkhorn, where the curvature-homogeneity alignment loss is evaluated. Levels 2 and 3 use the curved distance only.
C_ik = d_c(exp_0^c(z_i), exp_0^c(e_k)) - lambda_b * s_i * tanh(sqrt(c)||e_k||); L_curv = (1/m^2) sum_{i,j in S} ((1 - 2|s_i - s_j|) - wbar) * <Sinkhorn(-C/tau)_i, Sinkhorn(-C/tau)_j>

implementation_cost.claim: declared cost of the frozen run
implementation_cost.value: One training run only. Extra per step: B*K1*d MACs for the Poincare distance (B = 1024, K1 = 256, d as baseline, about 17M MACs at d = 64), m^2*K1 = 4.2M MACs for L_curv, and the same number of Sinkhorn iterations as the baseline, only on different numbers. Cohesion is a one-off CPU precompute over the training split (minutes). At the frozen scale of 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps, overhead is about +9 +/- 3 ms/step, under 5 percent of Stage 2 wall clock (roughly 11 to 15 extra minutes on four cards); Stage 3 cost unchanged because SIDs are assigned once. Memory: one 24556-vector and one B*K1 distance buffer, no extra parameters.
